verdict.rationale: Loops documents an official CLI with a dedicated page covering contacts, events and transactional email from the terminal. It offers multiple install paths (curl, Homebrew, PowerShell, Go), JSON output for scripting, multi-team auth, and a one-command install of the CLI plus agent skills. That clearly targets AI-native and agent workflows. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the CLI works as documented.
